# Create Convex project (`create_convex_project`)

MCP tool `repository_convex_createProject` · scope `access_provider_connections` · write

Creates one Convex project with a production deployment in the region given, else in the
organization default region (US East when no default is saved), in the Convex team connected to the
repository's organization. Samebase checks the provider-write lock, the exact repository code
location, the project name, and the organization quota before the create request, then records the
project as an attachment at that code location. One discovered code location is used without asking
when GitHub returned the whole file tree; several, or a partial tree, return an error that lists the
visible ones. An existing project name is rejected. If Samebase cannot record a created project, the
error says so.

## Arguments

- `repository` (string, required): The repository as GitHub owner/name, or its repositoryId from
  repository_list.
- `projectName` (string, required): Name for the new Convex project. An existing name is rejected.
- `convexDeploymentRegion` (value, optional): Optional production region: aws-us-east-1,
  aws-eu-west-1, aws-ca-central-1, or aws-ap-southeast-2. Omit it to use the organization default,
  which is US East when no default is saved. Before you pass aws-eu-west-1, tell the user: EU usage
  costs 1.3 times US usage, and included usage for Starter and Professional plans does not apply to
  EU deployments (https://www.convex.dev/pricing).
- `codeLocation` (string, optional): Optional code location from repository_convex_findProjects: a
  convex.json path or a convex/ directory. Omit it when the repository has one code location.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "projectName": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "codeLocation": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "deploymentRegion": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "const": "aws-us-east-1"
        },
        {
          "const": "aws-eu-west-1"
        },
        {
          "const": "aws-ca-central-1"
        },
        {
          "const": "aws-ap-southeast-2"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": ["projectName", "codeLocation", "deploymentRegion"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
